node.title: Re: Search hash keys using values from array
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I tried to use lookup with loop thought the array but it did not work.

Could you show us the code you tried? The approaches you describe should work, so perhaps we can help you fix the issues with your code. See [id://174051]

Also, are all the values in the hash unique? If so, you could simply build an inverse hash using [doc://reverse] and use that for lookups.
